targets.rawSql: SELECT TO_TIMESTAMP(s.last_updated_ts) AS time, s.state::float AS "pompa W" FROM states s JOIN states_meta sm ON s.metadata_id = sm.metadata_id WHERE sm.entity_id = 'sensor.pool_pump_power' AND s.state ~ '^-?[0-9.]+$' AND s.last_updated_ts BETWEEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM $__timeFrom()) AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM $__timeTo()) ORDER BY 1

SELECT TO_TIMESTAMP(s.last_updated_ts) AS time, s.state::float AS "export W" FROM states s JOIN states_meta sm ON s.metadata_id = sm.metadata_id WHERE sm.entity_id = 'sensor.solar_panel_to_grid_w' AND s.state ~ '^-?[0-9.]+$' AND s.last_updated_ts BETWEEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM $__timeFrom()) AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM $__timeTo()) ORDER BY 1

SELECT TO_TIMESTAMP(s.last_updated_ts) AS time, s.state::float AS value FROM states s JOIN states_meta sm ON s.metadata_id = sm.metadata_id WHERE sm.entity_id = 'sensor.pool_pump_runtime_today_min' AND s.state ~ '^[0-9.]+$' ORDER BY s.last_updated_ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT TO_TIMESTAMP(s.last_updated_ts) AS time, s.state::float AS value FROM states s JOIN states_meta sm ON s.metadata_id = sm.metadata_id WHERE sm.entity_id = 'sensor.pool_pump_energy_daily' AND s.state ~ '^[0-9.]+$' ORDER BY s.last_updated_ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', TO_TIMESTAMP(s.last_updated_ts)) AS time, MAX(s.state::float) AS "kWh" FROM states s JOIN states_meta sm ON s.metadata_id = sm.metadata_id WHERE sm.entity_id = 'sensor.pool_pump_energy_daily' AND s.state ~ '^[0-9.]+$' AND s.last_updated_ts BETWEEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM $__timeFrom()) AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM $__timeTo()) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
